question: If \(x^2+px+q=(x+2)(x-5)\), find the values of \(p\) and \(q\).
solution: \((x+2)(x-5)=x^2-3x-10\). Comparing coefficients gives \(p=-3\) and \(q=-10\). Factorization and polynomial multiplication are inverse operations.
